answers.core: This is most applicable to GDExtensions and custom modules and only pertains to core containers which can't be changed by addons. Since its often recommended that a change in godot-cpp should sync up first with godot, optimally godot's version of the types should be changed first.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around by const_cast'ing away the const or templating/duplicating the iterator code. However these are suboptimal solutions.

title: Add implicit conversion of container `Iterator`s to `ConstIterator`s
